about: Measured from the rendered frames of SCION-02 (Reiniger). x_screen/y_screen: centroid of the rendered dog silhouette (px, 1280x720, scene frame i = film frame i+72). facing: 1 = muzzle toward the door (left), -1 = away, 0 = no muzzle visible (end-on body or head turned into depth); measured from separately rendered muzzle and cranium masks. left_m/right_m: silhouette extent in score metres (x = (px - 352)/175). posture: from the puppet state that produced the frame.
